assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production transparent character sprite atlas for an existing 2D/2.5D game. Image 1 (fish) is the MATERIAL / ILLUSTRATION STYLE reference only. Image 2 is the EXISTING CHARACTER DESIGN reference. Render ONLY the four animals in the FIRST ROW of Image 2, each front and back: fox, bear, rabbit, cat. Preserve their exact recognisable species, head-to-body proportions, markings, outfits and colours. Change the rendering technique to the fish's exceptionally delicate coloured-pencil/gouache illustration, pearlescent soft dimensional shading, tiny directional fur strokes, luminous ivory highlights, fine tinted contours instead of thick purple vector outlines. Clothes should have satin-like painted depth, subtle fabric weave and neatly drawn seams, not fish scales or added decorations. Glossy small black oval eyes with restrained highlights; friendly cute expressions. Orange fox with cream cheeks and tail tip, orange cream-trim suit; warm brown bear in blue hoodie; ivory rabbit with long rounded pink-lined ears and pink cream-trim dress and boots; golden cream cat with one dark ear, purple cream-trim outfit. Full-body neutral standing poses, arms slightly separated, both feet on same baseline, all ears and tails visible. Exact regular 4-column by 2-row layout: TOP ROW front fox, front bear, front rabbit, front cat. BOTTOM ROW rear fox, rear bear, rear rabbit, rear cat, no faces on backs. Equal cells, character centred in each cell, generous clear gutters between cells, head body height consistent across rows, rabbit taller only because ears. Landscape high-resolution atlas, ideally 2048x1536. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor or cast shadows, no scenery, no grid, no text, no labels, no watermarks. Keep every complete silhouette isolated; no overlap. Not a 3D plastic render, not vector art, not photorealistic animals. Match the hand-painted fish reference's rich fine surface detail and luminous finish.
